findings.text: blocking: RUN_FAILED_STATUSES drops "blocked", so a head that reads blocked no longer closes its waiter as blocked-upstream, and tests/test_queue_dag_waits.py::test_closed_upstream_blocks_its_waiter[blocked] (parametrize ["blocked", "failed"] at tests/test_queue_dag_waits.py:293) goes red: the reviewed run's own suite pair records 2 failed at base and 3 failed at head with that id added (logs/base_suite.log, logs/head_suite.log), while the done-when requires the test files importing the changed modules to add no failure against the base revision; the repair is to drop "blocked" from that parametrisation and add an abandoned case under a scope grant, or to drop the blocked upstream waiter behaviour from this node.

non-blocking: _plan_review_owed runs the whole gate once per queued pointer on every admission pass with no per-pass cache, resolving the flight config (plan_review.review_coverage calls flight.resolve when config is None), listing stored reviews and re-reading the plan each time, while _rederive_waits at :2033 deliberately caches its plan read for the same pass; fold a per-pass cache keyed by (project, plan) into the same node.

non-blocking: the diff changes the file mode of reckon/crew/obligations.py, reckon/crew/queue_admission.py and reckon/crew/routing.py from 100644 to 100755 (git diff --summary), churn that carries no content reason and lands on the primary branch on merge.

non-blocking: the done-when requires ruff check and ruff format --check to pass on the changed paths, and the worker ran both in-session, but the manifest's tests/test_logs lines record no ruff command or result and no ruff log sits under logs/, so the recorded gate omits that half of the measure.
